top_violation_types.title: Household Members Qualifications - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1401(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Documentation verifying completion of orientation was not available for three household members.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant in care did not have updated feeding instructions within the past thirty days.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Supply Soap and Individual Towels (26 TAC §747.4205)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There are no paper towels in the bathroom. A single towel was provided for all the children to dry their hands.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Menus (26 TAC §747.801(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no menu made to review.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a written activity plan.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.
